newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 12.

text.p: The following stories were reported on Lithuania's radio station M1 Plus at noon on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuania's Workers' Union intends to rally in front of the government and parliament houses today to request higher compensation for people disabled at work.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas started his official visit to Japan today. Brazauskas intends to facilitate economic co-operation between the two countries.
- Lithuanian diplomats are working in Bern to establish a no-visa regime between Lithuania and Switzerland.
- A two-day marine military exercise starts in Lithuania's territorial waters today. Two Danish military ships will participate in the war games.
